artwork.paintingLabel: On the Shore of the Seine
artwork.abstract: Paysage Bords de Seine  (On the Shore of the Seine or Landscape on the Banks of the Seine) is an 1879 oil painting by Pierre-Auguste Renoir. It was stolen in 1951 from the Baltimore Museum of Art and resurfaced in 2012.\n\n

prompt: Generate a square image that closely matches a small Impressionist riverside landscape. The composition should feel panoramic but set within a square, with the left and center occupied by a softly glowing bank of foliage in yellow-green, mint, and pale pink. A calm river or inlet appears behind the vegetation, with a few vertical reeds or slender branches rising near the center. In the distance at far left, include faint dark tree forms or poplar-like silhouettes. Use feathery, blurred brushstrokes and a light, hazy atmosphere. Add tiny red accents among the greenery, a cream-toned ground, and a slightly aged linen texture.
